system.description:
Resting both your arms together, you transform them into a single, large chakra cannon.

The cannon shoots a beam in a 10-foot wide, 90-foot-long line that forces all creatures in its range to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, affected creatures reduces their Temporary Hit Points to 0, reduce their DR by 2 for the next minute and then take 7d10 force damage. On a success, they instead first reduce their current Temporary Hit Points by half and then take half of the listed damage.

After the initial casting, you are able to choose to maintain the cannon. If you do, you gain the following effects for the duration:

Your Speed is set to 0.

You gain a bonus 10 DR. You cannot be moved against your will, knocked Prone or Stunned.

As an Action on your turn, you may choose to fire the beam again. Draw a line originating from you as if you cast it again, this line does not need to be in the same direction as when you first cast this jutsu. You force all creatures in range to make their saving throws as normal. This beam penetrates environmental structures that aren’t made as a result of a Jutsu, ignoring their Hit Points and Resistances, if any.

At the start of each of your turns, you may choose to end this jutsu and de-form the cannon. You do not always have to fire the cannon each turn.

You only need to pay the concentration cost of this jutsu, when you refire the beam.

Amplify: By spending 5 Natural Energy as part of this jutsu’s casting, its range becomes Self (60-foot cone).

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above A-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, the range by 10 feet, and the damage by 1d10.
